audit.why: Level 1 neutral, Ambessa from 2 through the item phase, and only teamfights come back to Sejuani. This matches the packet levelChart and matches the already-audited mirror at audits/top/ambessa__sejuani.json, which rates the same stages from her side. I reused that mirror rather than re-deriving the lane, and stated the same facts from Sejuani's perspective.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and whys[1] place her level 2 spike on 'Ambessa's W', described as 'a dash that deals heavy damage on contact'.
audit.why: Repudiation is her W and it is not a dash. Riot's text: 'Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground' at 325 range. The dash the entry means is Drakehound's Step, her passive: entering a move command while casting any ability makes her dash and empowers her next attack. Getting this wrong inverts the counterplay — the entry tells the reader to bait out a W that has no mobility on it, when the thing they actually need to respect fires off every single cast and cannot be baited at all. The real level 2 spike is Lacerate plus the passive dash. Separately spikes[2].text names Sundered Sky or Black Cleaver; I removed the item names as unverifiable from the kit files.
audit.corrected: whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] now name Drakehound's Step and Lacerate correctly, and Repudiation is described as the shield it is, with its 18s rank-1 cooldown, in mid and phases[3].why.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json (P Drakehound's Step; W Repudiation cd 18/17/16/15/14, range 325; E Lacerate cd 13/12/11/10/9)

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions are absent. Public Execution blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in a line — never stated, and it is the one thing Sejuani's positioning controls. Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which blanks Lacerate, her only sticking tool — never stated. Repudiation's shield absorbs the opener — never stated. The full layer also names a nonexistent ability, 'Dash Chain', in winCon, enemyWin, loading, phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text: 'Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival.' That makes her ultimate a positioning problem with a correct answer: a tank standing in FRONT of her carries is the near target, not the far one, so she cannot reach past you — and if she does take you instead of a carry, a 130-second suppression spent on the tank is a trade Sejuani wants. No field in the entry mentions this. Frost Armor's slow immunity is the second: Lacerate is her only slow, and while Frost Armor holds it does nothing, which is why breaking contact works at all. Repudiation is the third — an 18s shield that eats whatever you open with, so the opener should be spent forcing it, not carrying your damage. 'Dash Chain' is not an Ambessa ability under any spelling and appears five times in the full layer.
audit.corrected: Public Execution's farthest-target rule and Frost Armor's slow immunity are now in late; Repudiation's shield and 18s cooldown are in mid, phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns; breakdown.cooldowns replaces 'Dash Chain' with Drakehound's Step and adds Public Execution at 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'passive Permafrost armor', 'passive Permafrost stacks' and 'passive Permafrost resistances' appear in whys[1], whys[5], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[2], early and mid; mid also calls the Glacial Prison bola 'the comet'.
audit.why: Permafrost has no passive and no stacks — it is a 1.5s targeted stun gated on the Frost gauge. The resistances are Frost Armor on Fury of the North, and they come back only after she is out of combat, which is the actual instruction hiding under all six of those sentences: break contact. 'Comet' is a rune, not part of her kit; a reader will look for it in her ability list and not find it.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor is named correctly in spikes[2].text, wants.foe[2], early and mid, each time with the out-of-combat condition attached. 'Comet' replaced with the bola and its 1300 range.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (P and E descriptions; R range 1300)

edits.after: At level 1 neither of you has a real kill threat — sit at max auto range, apply Frost with autos, and last-hit safely; she has no kill pattern yet either. Level 2 changes it: Drakehound's Step means any ability plus a movement command gives her a free dash and an empowered auto, so she closes and leaves before Frost Armor can come back. Do not spend Arctic Assault trying to knock her up — she dashes sideways through it and punishes an 18-second cooldown. At level 3 the Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam pattern is live; stand far enough that the sweep clips a minion, not you, and only go for the Q-W-E chain if she overshoots and stands still.
edits.before: At level 1 neither of you has a real kill threat — sit at max auto range, apply Frost with autos, and last-hit safely; she has no kill pattern yet either. The moment she hits level 2 everything changes: Ambessa's W is a dash that deals heavy damage on contact and she will immediately use it to blow up your passive Permafrost stacks before you can build them back up. Do not waste Arctic Assault trying to knock her up — she will simply dash sideways through it and punish the cooldown. At level 3 she has her full W-dash-into-extended-combo ready; stand just far enough that her W lands on a minion, not you, and only attempt the Q-W-E Permafrost chain if she overshoots and is standing still.

edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are a free farm period — she wins every duel and you must accept it. Break contact the instant Frost Armor drops so it can return, absorb her damage with the second Winter's Wrath arc rather than your body, and use Arctic Assault strictly as an escape when she dives you, never as an engage. Level 6 is the first moment you can threaten a kill: Glacial Prison travels 1300 units, so throw it from outside her range, and a connect gives you a free Q-W-E Permafrost stun chain that your jungler converts. Hold the bola until Repudiation is spent — the shield is 18s at rank 1 and it will otherwise absorb your entire opener.
edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a free farm period — she wins every duel and you must accept it. Keep your passive armor up by backing away the instant it breaks, absorb her W poke with the second Winter's Wrath strike rather than your body, and use Arctic Assault strictly as an escape when she dives you, not as an engage. Level 6 is the first moment you can threaten a kill: Glacial Prison travels far enough that you can throw it from outside her W dash range, and if it connects you get a free Q-W-E Permafrost stun chain that your jungler converts into a kill. Keep the ult on ice until she burns her W and has no immediate dash to dodge the comet.

edits.after: In a full teamfight Sejuani neutralises Ambessa's mobility — the Glacial Prison blizzard catches her mid-dash, and the Permafrost stun locks her down for your team. Positioning is the real answer to Public Execution: it blinks her to the farthest enemy champion in the line she picks, so standing in front of your carries means she takes you and not them, which for a tank is the trade you want. Avoid isolated 1v1s even with two items. Frost Armor also makes you immune to the Lacerate slow, so once you break contact she has no way to stick to you.
edits.before: In a full teamfight Sejuani neutralises Ambessa's mobility advantage — Glacial Prison blizzard catches her mid-dash, and once the Permafrost stun lands she is completely locked down for your team to collapse on. Avoid any isolated 1v1 even with two items; her W resets let her re-engage after your stun expires and she will out-DPS your passive resistances in a prolonged fight. Play the edge of teamfights: position to land Glacial Prison on Ambessa as she leaps into your back line, then follow with Arctic Assault and Permafrost to keep her neutralised until the fight is decided.

edits.before: Frost stacks decide every trade: fight only when the full Q-W-E chain is available. Track Dash Chain before stepping up.

edits.after: - Ambessa Drakehound's Step: matchup-defining — a free dash off every cast; fight when she has just spent one. - Repudiation: 18s at rank 1, and the shield eats your opener. - Public Execution: 130s at rank 1. - Your Q is an 18s exit, not an entry.
edits.before: - Ambessa Dash Chain: matchup-defining — Her passive dash weaving — fight when the chain is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
